items.t: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit in Shenzhen
items.d: The three leaders meet today on the sidelines of APEC. Iran, a possible nuclear arms deal and the US-China tariff truce are on the table, but analysts expect mostly symbolic results.

items.t: Iran widens Gulf attacks, targeting US base in Kuwait and Bahrain
items.d: Kuwait says it intercepted drones aimed at a US air base, as the nine-month US-Israel war with Iran escalates around the Gulf and tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.t: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83 a share
items.d: The Claude maker priced above its range, raising over $81bn in the largest listing on record. Shares start trading on Nasdaq today under the ticker ANT.

items.t: UN court to rule on whether Myanmar committed genocide
items.d: The International Court of Justice is due to give its verdict on the Rohingya massacres. No state has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court.

items.t: Russian arrested in US for spying on Palantir staff
items.d: Prosecutors say the suspect tailed employees of the defence-tech firm over its support for Ukraine and carried fake US IDs and two Russian passports.

items.t: China threatens retaliation over US curbs on overseas AI computing
items.d: Beijing warned of countermeasures after Washington moved to stop Chinese firms renting advanced US chips in data centres abroad, mainly in South East Asia.

items.t: Nvidia posts record $115.8bn revenue, but shares slide
items.d: Sales doubled and it forecasts about $130bn next quarter, excluding China. The board ruled out reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, and the stock fell nearly 3%.

items.t: FTSE 100 drops 1.3% as metal prices tumble
items.d: Miners led the fall as gold, silver and copper slid on a stronger dollar and AI doubts. UK inflation rose to 3.6%, slightly below forecasts.

items.t: Hang Seng falls below 23,000 as tech stocks slump
items.d: Hong Kong shares dropped almost 2% by midday, with Tencent and Alibaba down 6-7%, as the Shenzhen summit got under way.

items.t: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.d: Astra is a frontier model for hard coding and research work; Sol is a cheaper everyday model. Both come to paid ChatGPT plans, Codex and the API.

items.t: 'Java4Shell' flaw lets hackers take over Java servers
items.d: A critical bug in Java's Base64 decoder allows remote code execution without login. US agency CISA urges firms to patch and restart every Java process now.

items.t: Nvidia's new leaders reportedly pull out of China
items.d: After Jensen Huang's ouster, the company is said to be halting chip sales to China, a market it had fought hard to keep.

items.t: Jensen Huang to testify to Congress on 1 December
items.d: The former Nvidia boss agreed to face House committees examining possible national security breaches, with Nvidia's general counsel appearing the next day.

items.t: Microsoft releases cheaper MAI Code 2 coding models
items.d: MAI Code 2 and a lighter Flash version aim to match rivals for everyday software work at a fraction of the cost. Both are in GitHub Copilot.

items.t: Google to keep some Gemini chats for two months
items.d: Even with history turned off, chats will be kept for about two months instead of 72 hours, for safety and operations. Users can still opt out of training.

items.t: US officially loses measles elimination status
items.d: After 26 years, the US is no longer measles-free: about 5,400 cases and 10 deaths this year, the worst since the 1990s, amid falling vaccination.

items.t: Why a billion years vanished from Earth's rock record
items.d: A Nature study suggests slow mantle movements lifted continents so erosion wiped away old rock, explaining the 'Great Unconformity' gap.

items.t: New test for a possible twist in the universe's oldest light
items.d: UC San Diego physicists built a method to check a hinted rotation in Planck data; it matches earlier results, which could point to new physics.

items.t: 'Feudal' leasehold to be scrapped in England and Wales
items.d: A new bill would end leasehold for most new homes and cap ground rent at £250 a year.

items.t: Bayesian crew unaware of risks, investigators find
items.d: The report into the superyacht sinking off Sicily, which killed seven including tech tycoon Mike Lynch, says the crew did not know the danger.

items.t: Prince Harry says he would rejoin the army
items.d: Warning of the threat from Russia, the Duke of Sussex said people should be ready to serve their country again if needed.

items.t: 特朗普、習近平與普京深圳首度三方會談
items.d: 三國領袖今日在APEC峰會期間會面，議題包括伊朗、可能的核軍控協議及中美關稅休戰，但分析認為成果多屬象徵性。

items.t: 伊朗擴大海灣攻擊 目標包括科威特美軍基地及巴林
items.d: 科威特稱攔截了襲擊美軍空軍基地的無人機。美以與伊朗的戰爭已持續九個月，戰火正蔓延至海灣及荷姆茲海峽的油輪。

items.t: Anthropic招股價定83美元 創史上最大IPO
items.d: Claude開發商以高於招股範圍的價格定價，集資逾810億美元，為史上最大規模上市。股份今日在納斯達克掛牌，代號ANT。

items.t: 國際法院將裁決緬甸是否犯種族滅絕罪
items.d: 國際法院將就羅興亞人遭屠殺一案作出裁決。至今從未有國家被國際法院裁定犯種族滅絕罪。

items.t: 俄羅斯男子在美被捕 涉監視Palantir員工
items.d: 檢方指疑犯因Palantir支援烏克蘭而跟蹤其員工，身上搜出偽造美國證件及兩本俄羅斯護照。

items.t: 中方揚言反制美國限制海外AI算力
items.d: 美國擬禁止中國企業透過東南亞等海外數據中心租用先進美國晶片，北京警告將採取反制措施。

items.t: Nvidia收入創新高達1158億美元 股價仍下跌
items.d: 收入按年翻倍，預計下季約1300億美元（不計中國）。董事會表明不會讓黃仁勳復任行政總裁，股價跌近3%。

items.t: 富時100指數跌1.3% 金屬價格急挫
items.d: 美元轉強及市場對AI存疑，金、銀、銅價下滑，礦業股領跌。英國通脹升至3.6%，略低於預期。

items.t: 恒指失守23000點 科技股急跌
items.d: 港股半日跌近2%，騰訊及阿里巴巴跌6%至7%，深圳峰會同日舉行。

items.t: OpenAI推出GPT-6.2 Astra及Sol
items.d: Astra針對高難度編程及研究工作，Sol則是較便宜的日常模型，兩者均開放予ChatGPT付費用戶、Codex及API。

items.t: 「Java4Shell」漏洞可讓黑客遙控Java伺服器
items.d: Java的Base64解碼器出現嚴重漏洞，無需登入即可遠程執行程式碼。美國網絡安全局促請企業立即更新並重啟所有Java程序。

items.t: 據報Nvidia新管理層撤出中國市場
items.d: 黃仁勳被撤職後，據報公司將停止向中國銷售晶片，放棄其一直力保的市場。

items.t: 黃仁勳12月1日到國會作供
items.d: Nvidia前行政總裁同意出席眾議院委員會聆訊，交代可能的國家安全漏洞，公司法律總顧問翌日亦會作供。

items.t: Microsoft推出平價編程模型MAI Code 2
items.d: MAI Code 2及輕量版Flash以遠低於對手的成本處理日常軟件開發，已加入GitHub Copilot。

items.t: Google將保留部分Gemini對話兩個月
items.d: 即使關閉記錄，對話亦會保留約兩個月（原為72小時），作安全及營運用途；用戶仍可拒絕用作訓練。

items.t: 美國正式失去「麻疹消除」地位
items.d: 美國時隔26年失去麻疹消除地位，今年約5400宗病例、10人死亡，為1990年代以來最多，疫苗接種率下降。

items.t: 地球岩層缺失十億年之謎或有解
items.d: 《自然》期刊研究指，地幔緩慢對流令大陸抬升，舊岩層被侵蝕，或可解釋「大不整合面」的缺口。

items.t: 宇宙最古老光線或有扭轉 新方法驗證
items.d: 加州大學聖地牙哥分校物理學家以新方法分析普朗克衛星數據，結果與早前研究吻合，或指向新物理。

items.t: 英格蘭及威爾斯將廢除「封建」租賃業權制
items.d: 新法案將令大部分新建住宅不再採用租賃業權，並把地租上限定為每年250英鎊。

items.t: 調查指Bayesian遊艇船員事前不知風險
items.d: 遊艇在西西里島對開沉沒，釀成包括科技富豪Mike Lynch在內七人死亡；調查報告指船員不知危險。

items.t: 哈里王子稱願重返軍隊
items.d: 薩塞克斯公爵警告俄羅斯威脅，認為國民應準備在有需要時再為國效力。
